chart-panel.name: Chart Panel
chart-panel.purpose: Show one compact chart summary by framing the Charts primitive with title, value, caption, ECharts option output, and read-only fallback plot.

variants.description: Compact trend card from the ZIP Sparkline reference.
Vertical bar panel from the ZIP Bars reference.
Trend-first line panel, including bounded multi-series comparison when labels are explicit.
Trend panel with subtle filled area.
Sorted driver chart with cumulative threshold.
Small panel where the summary carries the reading.

chart-panel.statePrecedence: disabled > error > warning > focus > hover > default

Energy.decision: Use semantic chart, text, warning, and error color.

Voice.decision: Use concise title, value, and caption.
Voice.behavior: Chart meaning is readable before parsing pixels.

Frame.decision: Use stable chart width and plot area.

Depth.behavior: Chart is framed without becoming a card stack.

Momentum.decision: Use Design System transitions and reduced motion.

State.decision: Disabled and error resolve before warning and focus.

Tone.decision: Use tone for operational attention, not decoration.
Tone.behavior: Warning and error have semantic copy.

Symbol.decision: Use symbols only to support panel meaning.

Iconography.decision: Use Design System icon sizing when actions exist.

Accessibility.decision: Provide title, role, label, and text summary.
Accessibility.behavior: Chart can be understood without vision.

props.name: values
props.notes: Local chart values rendered inside the component.

props.name: labels
props.notes: Optional labels for chart values, used by donut, bullet, bars, and accessible titles.

props.name: segments
props.notes: Optional part-to-whole data for donut panels.

props.name: variant
props.notes: Local visualization treatment: sparkline, bars, line, area, donut, pareto, bullet, comparison, or compact.

props.name: state
props.notes: Visual state: default, focus, hover, warning, error, or disabled.

props.name: tone
props.notes: Semantic tone for value and plot emphasis.

props.name: fullWidth
props.notes: Lets the panel fill its parent grid column.

dont: Do not hide value in pixels.
info: Visualization engine may vary by platform.

agentInstructions: Use Chart Panel for one known metric.
Keep data meaning and period explicit.
rejectIf: Comparison and Pareto render as generic bars
Chart Panel renders data without the Charts primitive.
ECharts option and fallback disagree on values or labels.
Interactive chart marks cannot be reached by keyboard.
Demos use placeholder data that reads as decoration.
accessibility: Expose textSummary and tableFallback from the Charts primitive.
Hydrate Apache ECharts only when the runtime provides it; keep the fallback readable otherwise.
